label: caiso import cap floor
definition: CAISO keeper: this session's aggregate WECC simultaneous-import cap (8.3 GW) + per-tranche delivered-cost basis over the measured hub MCE, run with the validated RA gas-commitment floor (0.80) and negative renewable offers ON. The floor mechanisms make the model long midday so the price floor crashes to reality: 2024 negative-price hours 815 (~800 actual), LMP p10 $1.40 / min -$20, net interchange -30.4 TWh vs -32.4 actual; 2025 net -38.6 vs -36.2. 2023 over-imports (net -40 vs -29, 99% import hours) because it has no measured WECC hub series (OASIS Jan-Feb aged out) and falls back to the static import ladder. Residual: mean LMP still ~$8 high (evening ramp — missing AS/reserve co-optimization) and diurnal phase corr negative (separate bidirectional-zone work).
